_note: The land's shape and colours (M2, crates/core/src/terrain.rs, lod.rs, scatter.rs). Heights are cm, distances m, colours 0 to 255, shares percent. The village plateau is height 0, so the game opens with its feet on the ground (world::START).
_noise: value noise, octave by octave: the plains' long swells, then smaller rises, then the facets' unevenness
_tilt_cm_per_km: the land falls gently toward the south, where the orcs come from (east, south)

mountains._note: Beyond the square the land rises into ridges, as scenery to the 16 km horizon (CW-Q14). They start rising this far past the square's edge and are whole by the second distance; each side has its own height. The river's valley cuts through them.

shading._note: Protection of the Spheres' faceted ground: each corner's seeded unevenness shades it, each facet a little more, steep faces turn to rock. The patchwork of tones is whole on the finest level and fades level by level, because a colour that changes from one tiny far facet to the next shimmers as the view moves (CW-18).

lod._note: Terrain in tiles round the camera (lod.rs): level 0 has 2 m cells, each level twice as coarse, to 128 m cells (PLAN.md, render::rings). A tile is split into four of the level below while the camera is inside the ring of that level, measured to the tile's nearest point; the outer band_pct of the ring hands over with the ordered dither. Tiles are built ahead of need inside prefetch_pct of a ring, at most builds_per_frame a frame, and forgotten outside evict_pct.
